# HQ

> HQ is the company brain your AI runs on. It keeps a company's knowledge, projects, skills, workflows, credentials and AI teammates in one shared system the company owns, and it works across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, ChatGPT and Claude. The core is open source (MIT).

Key facts:

- What it is: a suite of six connected products (HQ Core, HQ Cloud, Secrets + Integrations, HQ Deploy, HQ Bots, HQ MCP) that gives a company one way to work with AI. It does not replace AI tools or models. It gives them shared company context, tools and access.
- Who it's for: companies and teams that want everyone, technical or not, working from the same AI context. Common users are founders and operators, agencies running many client workspaces, and consumer brands. Nontechnical teammates usually use HQ through Claude Desktop or ChatGPT (via HQ MCP), Slack, email, or deployed apps. A smaller operator group installs HQ and builds skills.
- Pricing: sign up free with $10 of usage included every month and a 30-day free trial covering up to $500 of usage. After that, pay as you go. No seat fees. Deploys, DMs and background AI are free. Hosted AI agents run on boxes billed monthly by size, from $100 to $800. Enterprise is priced by contract. Full rates: https://hqforwork.com/pricing
- Free self-hosted option: the open-source HQ core and the HQ CLI run on your own machines with no HQ account and no cloud.
- Install: download the desktop app for macOS or Windows at https://hqforwork.com/install, or run `npx create-hq` in a terminal. A Linux desktop app is on a waitlist.
- Data: local-first. Company memory lives in ordinary files in the HQ workspace. When HQ Cloud is used, synced data is encrypted in transit and at rest, credentials get separate field-level encryption, and each company is an isolated tenant.
- Official domains: hqforwork.com (product site) and docs.hq.computer (documentation). Source code: https://github.com/indigoai-us/hq-core

## Products

- [All products](https://hqforwork.com/products): overview of the six products and how they fit together
- [HQ Core](https://hqforwork.com/products/core): open-source, file-based company memory (Knowledge, Skills, Projects, Workers, Policies) and the harness that loads it into every AI session
- [HQ Cloud](https://hqforwork.com/products/cloud): syncs HQ across the team and every device, with an admin console for membership and access
- [HQ Secrets + Integrations](https://hqforwork.com/products/integrations): connect company systems and MCP servers once, keep credentials encrypted, and grant use to people and bots without sharing raw keys
- [HQ Deploy](https://hqforwork.com/products/deploy): publish AI-made reports, dashboards, portals and apps as public, password-protected or company-only links
- [HQ Bots](https://hqforwork.com/products/bots): persistent AI teammates with a role, memory, tools, an email address and Slack access
- [HQ MCP](https://hqforwork.com/products/mcp): brings company memory, tools and connected systems into Claude and ChatGPT through one permissioned connection
- [Bot Directory](https://hqforwork.com/bots): preconfigured bots ready to name and deploy
- [Pack Marketplace](https://hqforwork.com/marketplace): installable packs of skills, workers and policies published by HQ creators

## Use cases

- [HQ for agencies](https://hqforwork.com/hq-for-agencies): an isolated HQ per client while the agency reuses its methods
- [Build a shared company brain](https://hqforwork.com/build-a-shared-company-brain): one approved source of company context for people and bots
- [Company-wide AI adoption](https://hqforwork.com/company-wide-ai-adoption): let teams pick their models while context and capabilities stay shared
- [Share AI skills with your team](https://hqforwork.com/share-ai-skills-with-your-team): turn one person's best workflow into a team command
- [Share AI tools securely](https://hqforwork.com/share-ai-tools-securely): give access to APIs, MCPs and data without passing credentials around
- [Connect company tools and data to AI](https://hqforwork.com/connect-company-tools-and-data-to-ai): connect each system once for the whole company
- [Govern AI access, knowledge and approvals](https://hqforwork.com/govern-ai-access-knowledge-and-approvals): role-based access and human approval gates
- [Set up bots that know your company](https://hqforwork.com/set-up-bots-that-know-your-company): persistent AI teammates with company context
- [Automate reports, dashboards and briefs](https://hqforwork.com/automate-reports-dashboards-and-briefs): recurring reporting from shared data and definitions
- [Schedule recurring AI work](https://hqforwork.com/schedule-recurring-ai-work): scheduled workflows with owners and review
- [Turn meetings into decisions and action](https://hqforwork.com/turn-meetings-into-decisions-and-action): meeting capture into decisions, owners and follow-ups
- [Keep brand voice consistent in AI](https://hqforwork.com/keep-brand-voice-consistent-in-ai): shared voice, claims and channel rules
- [Onboard teammates into AI work faster](https://hqforwork.com/onboard-teammates-into-ai-work-faster): new hires start with context and access on day one
- [Collaborate with AI](https://hqforwork.com/collaborate-with-ai): people and bots working on one project memory
- [Publish AI work as apps, portals and pages](https://hqforwork.com/publish-ai-work-as-apps-portals-and-pages): turn projects into shareable destinations
- [Run isolated client and brand workspaces](https://hqforwork.com/run-isolated-client-and-brand-workspaces): separate context and credentials per client or brand
